c298d8f8b405: Mock Exam 4 - Industrial Relations, Finance & VAT
2ff44b38084d: The WRC is responsible for promoting good employment practice and giving support and guidance to both employers and employees.
69f969f57c84: The Labour Court is the forum responsible for adjudicating on industrial disputes and issuing employment rulings and decisions.
43950316e58a: By law, if an employee requests it, the employer has a strict deadline of 14 days to give them the reasons for their dismissal in writing.
4f21ec846814: The general working time rules set a minimum entitlement of 11 consecutive hours of daily rest.
faeb532b7b77: A worker is entitled to a compulsory 30-minute break when their shift reaches 6 hours.
2b2008da1197: Although the core terms must be given within 5 days (Day 5 Statement), the full written contract or statement of employment terms must be given within the first month.
193026f1a161: To be entitled to SSP, the worker must have at least 13 weeks of continuous service with the company. Currently a maximum of 5 days a year is paid at 70% of salary.
3716b91bffaa: Statutory Sick Pay (SSP) is 70% of the employee's normal daily wage, with a maximum ceiling of €110 a day.
17638184097d: The law currently gives 9 weeks of Parent's Leave to each parent in the first two years.
23634ba95b02: Standard maternity leave is 26 weeks. (Mothers can request 16 extra unpaid weeks, but the standard legal basis is 26.)
299ea6c1810d: An employee must have a minimum of 2 years' continuous service with the employer to qualify for statutory redundancy pay.
bef0e52eb730: Dismissing an employee for their trade union membership or activity is an "inadmissible reason" and the dismissal is automatically considered unfair.
350eb6957f14: If an employee is unfairly dismissed but finds work immediately and suffers no financial loss, the maximum compensation is 4 weeks' pay.
506edc0e7137: The right to paid time off for ante-natal care appointments applies to all pregnant employees from day one, with no length-of-service requirement.
ff65106dcdd1: Workers have a legal right to up to 5 days of paid leave a year for reasons of domestic violence.
54ea5253e187: The employee is only legally obliged to give 1 week's notice to resign, and this period does not increase however many years they have been with the company.
8b73e46e96cb: According to the notice scale, employees with 15 years' service or more are entitled to a minimum of 8 weeks' notice from the company.
882b1a97693f: The Working Time Directive sets a legal maximum of 48 working hours a week on average (normally calculated over a 4-month reference period).
6f9de73a005a: Once the union holds the ballot, the strike or industrial action must start within the following 4 weeks.
f0c4a559e9b2: Picketing can only take place near the workers' own workplace. However, union officials are allowed to accompany their members on picket lines.
8660bf9d2fd5: Cash flow measures only the money coming into (receipts) and going out of (payments) a company.
bad712c5e911: Debt factoring means "selling" your unpaid invoices to a finance company to get cash immediately and improve cash flow.
b23c55247c8b: The formula for calculating the percentage budget variance is: (Variance / Budgeted Amount) x 100.
f4c0048999af: The four core elements of the classic marketing mix are: Product (the service offered), Price, Place and Promotion.
048689e93609: SMART is an acronym for setting effective objectives: Specific, Measurable, Achievable, Relevant and Time-bound.
24f4b746c861: Primary data is data you collect yourself first-hand. Personal or telephone interviews and direct surveys are primary research methods.
f0c85ff922ff: The standard Value Added Tax (VAT) rate for most goods and services in Ireland is 23%.
73fdd707625d: The compulsory threshold for registering for VAT if your company supplies services (such as passenger transport) is turnover of more than €42,500.
888b98c18bf3: In cross-border B2B transactions within the EU, VAT is not charged on the invoice. The European customer applies the "reverse charge" mechanism and accounts for the VAT in their own country.
3b4b87a2f760: Revenue requires all VAT-related records and books of account to be kept for a minimum of 6 years.
e0dcf7dc59d8: Dublin's M50 motorway is known for its eFlow system, which has no physical barriers and reads vehicles' number plates or electronic tags without them having to stop.
4d8e8aee4d6b: eFlow is the barrier-free toll on the M50: cameras read the number plate. GO-Box is Austria's, LKW-Maut is Germany's (lorries) and AutoPASS is Norway's.
d7f2c2c87744: The four pillars for holding an operator licence are: Good Repute, Financial Standing, Professional Competence and a real Establishment in Ireland.
e598b4607e27: To maintain good repute, the Department will check whether the operator or manager has committed serious offences in the last 5 years.
ce97dce21311: Financial standing requires proving a financial cushion of €9,000 for the first authorised vehicle.
d0fef5b1ac27: For each additional bus added to the licence (after the first), the company must prove an additional €5,000 of financial reserves.

9055bfe75906: If a collective redundancy is triggered, the company is legally obliged to open a consultation and information period of at least 30 days with the trade union or worker representatives before any redundancy takes effect.
fd45ac26cfab: To calculate the vehicle's depreciation, you must first subtract the cost of the original tyres (because tyres are a variable running cost, not a fixed asset). €90,000 - €2,500 = €87,500. 20% of €87,500 is €17,500.
a373ae0d3cc1:
1. Fixed cost per km = €60,000 / 50,000 km = €1.20 per km.
2. Total cost per km = €1.20 (fixed) + €0.40 (variable/running) = €1.60.
3. Profit margin (20%) = 20% of €1.60 = €0.32.
4. Price to quote = €1.60 + €0.32 = €1.92.
